notes.title: Patch from 12/25/2024: Gamepad support and other updates!
notes.content:
Hello! In this update, we’ve made several major additions to the game. Among them are gamepad support, additional settings, and improvements to the final scenes of the game.

[b]Important changes:[/b]
• Now you can play the entire game with your gamepad. It works everywhere except the main menu and pause menu, where you’ll have to use the mouse.
• We’ve added new details to the environment, changed the effects, animations, and details of the final scenes in the game to make them more dramatic and better convey the essence of the moment.
• New options have been added to the settings — now, if you wish, you can turn off Grain and the Fisheye effects.
• A number of missing sounds related to player movement have been added. For example: examining the bed, crawling under the bed, moments when we sit down and get up.
• We made many additional edits to improve visual elements and sounds.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch from 11/29/2024
notes.content:
Hello! In this update we’ve added many changes that will improve the quality of scenes, sounds and visual elements of the game.

List of changes:
• We improved visuals during inspection of objects.
• The speed of changing the camera FOV from running to cutscene has been changed to make the transition to cutscenes smoother.
• We eliminated a number of moments when the player could physically leave the dialogue before it was completed since it could cause bugs.
• We changed the settings for the Credits button in the main menu so that it has sounds and works like other buttons. Timing during Credits have been improved.
• The volume of many sounds, as well as attenuation of sounds were changed to make the sounds more natural.
• We changed the position of dialogue bubbles so that they look better and didn’t clutter the screen.
• The visual effects of various controls were changed so that they would not conflict with each other.
• We changed materials and improved models of some objects.
• We changed the collision of some objects that were causing bugs.
• We removed a couple of Robin's phrases that do not convey important information to improve the pacing of some scenes.
• Day 0. We added the ability to start a conversation with the administrator by ringing the bell.
• Day 0. We fixed discrepancies in sounds and effects during explosions outside the window.
• Day 1. We added sounds for the hero's reaction to some events.
• Day 1. We added a pixel mask for the Lady in White.
• Day 2. We disabled the crawler effects when he breaks the clock to improve visual quality of the scene.
• Day 2. We made some edits to the dream to more accurately convey its meaning.
• Day 3. Robin walked through the door during the date. Fixed.
• Day 3. We improved the timing of the Lady in White's movement to improve the cutscene.
• Day 3. We changed the player's position in the dream and added sounds to improve the scene.
• Day 7. We changed a number of sounds during the chase in the pool and added new sounds.
• Day 7. We changed the sounds and effects of death from the environment and fixed several bugs that could occur at the moment of death.
• Day 8. We changed the sounds from the radio to improve the atmosphere.
• Day 8. We changed the sounds in the parking lot to improve the atmosphere.
• Day 8. We changed the model of the gun when the priest shoots the monster.
• Day 9. We changed the effect and sounds related to the last conversation in the elevator to improve the scene.
• Day 9. We changed the effects and sounds related to the last conversation with the priest to fix some bugs.
• Day 9. We added hallucination sounds in the restaurant.
• Day 9. We made adjustments to the sounds and effects of the last scenes in the dream to improve the atmosphere.
• We added many additional edits and bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch from 11/07/2024
notes.content:
Hello! This patch has a lot of small but important fixes. But first, we want to mention our voice actors who made The Inn-Sanity possible.

During development, we used sounds recorded by the wonderful actress Jenny Glynn for our previous project, Crimson Snow. Unfortunately, we did not credit her – it’s a big mistake on our part, which we will fix in this patch. Thanks to her, many scenes with the Ghost and the White Lady became much more tense. Thank you!

We also want to thank the voice who breathed life into our main partner in the hotel, Robin. She is voiced by the talented actress Lindsey "Asesina" Harbaugh. She added charm to our game and made our stay at the hotel less lonely!

And now on to the patch!

List of changes:
• Corrections to the Chinese translation. We fixed a number of mistakes and places where translation was missing.
• Day 1. Our room. Added a small hint on the table.
• Day 2. We removed double subtitles from the dream scene.
• Day 3. Roof. Added improvements to the surrounding view.
• Day 3. The hallucination when we walk along the corridor has been changed. The paintings are animated, background accompaniment has been added, sounds from the paintings and the post-process has been changed.
• Day 3. The appearance of the neighbor's room has been changed: books, suitcases, papers, pens, trash have been added. The photo in the neighbor's room was changed. We also changed its location.
• Day 3. Now after the time given by the priest is out, the conversation begins.
• Day 7. Lobby and pool. A number of background sounds were changed, improving the environment. We also fixed several sound artifacts and added additional sounds.
• Day 7. The movements of the giant monster now shake the floor.
• Day 7. When we finish the conversation with Robin after the chase, she began to walk and talk almost without pauses. We added pauses and changed the order of a couple of phrases.
• Day 8. Robin is now calling us on the roof, so it's easier to find her.
• Day 9. We changed the sounds outside the window to match the new environment.
• Several sounds throughout the game were replaced to better match the timing of cutscenes and the environment.
• The particles of drops are now displayed correctly and have sound.
• The particles of short circuit sparks have been reworked. We also added sound to them.
• We added sounds for Robin's footsteps. 
• We added the ability to view Credits from the main menu of the game. It’s a small feather at the right corner of the screen.
• We made many other edits to fix collision, decals, change the position of some objects and other things.

Thanks for the support!

notes.title: Patch from 10/26/2024
notes.content:
Hi! Here is the list of changes for this patch:

• We changed the crawler's reaction to the hero. For example, when the player gets too close, the crawler turns around and makes a warning sound.
• On Day 7, it was possible to drain gas from tanks before players were given the task to do so. Fixed.
• The sounds and timing of loads were changed on Day 2, 3 and 7. This made loading new scene smoother.
• Roof. The collision of objects was changed to avoid the possibility of jumping on tables.
• We added the sounds of eating food, which were missing during breakfast on Day 3.
• Fixed several bugs in sounds during the scene with a date in a restaurant (Day 3).
• We added rain sounds from windows on Day 3.
• We improved timing and volumes in significant number of sounds on Days 2 and 3.
• We changed the position of the notes on Day 3. We also added additional details to the level that surround one of the notes.


Write about your problems and wishes. We will try to take them into account in the next patches!

notes.title: Patch from 10/24/2024
notes.content:
Hello! In this update, we fixed several bugs, made several improvements, and also fixed a rare but important error that made the game unbeatable for some players.

• During the QTE event on Day 2, some players could not press the C button, and therefore could not progress further. As it turned out, this is due to the fact that some keyboards cannot correctly receive a simultaneous signal from the three keys we selected. To fix this, we temporarily simplified the QTE and removed the need to hold down the C key.

• When picking up a first aid kit, it was out of focus. Fixed.
• The first aid kit had an incorrect description in Russian. Fixed.
• Fixed the collision for the underwater section on Day 1. Now you can no longer climb on large boulders.
• A small visual scene was added to the underwater section of Day 1 to increase the atmosphere.
• We changed the lighting of pickup items in inspection mode so that they can be examined in more detail. A dark background was added to the description of items to make it easier to read.
• We removed the ability to switch the radio and listen to the news while the hero is talking to Robin. It was a bug. Also, it was impolite.
• The difficulty of the last dialogue with the priest has changed. Now it is a little easier to persuade him.
• The duration of the text display in the endings has been increased to make it easier to read. To do this, we also extended the video sequence and music.
• Minor edits have been made to the Chinese translation.
• The volume of a number of sounds and effects has been changed. We added the sounds of wind to the windows in Day 3.
• In the dream of the last day, you could notice a visual artifact in the form of a square in the distance. Fixed.
• We removed the sounds of rain from the windows in Day 2.
• We added an icon displaying the level of collected gasoline in Day 8.

Write about your problems and wishes. We will try to take them into account in the next patches!

notes.title: Hotfix 10/23/2024
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you for your messages and letters with the bugs you found. We have released a fix that solve some of the issues:

• During the QTE event on Day 2, the buttons were displayed incorrectly. Fixed.
• The checkpoint in the middle of Day 7 was not working correctly. Now you don't have to go through the entire level again.
• In the dialogue with the priest during Day 3, the window with the line did not close itself after the end of the conversation. Fixed.
• In Day 8, the blood from the crawler was visible before he was killed. Fixed.

Thank you for your positive feedback and comments! Wait for new updates!
